parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Design intent: V-001 is a three-phase FWKO at nominal 60 psig and 130 °F. It separates well fluid by density, sending gas to fuel gas (excess to burn pit), oil to the Heater–Treater and free water to water treatment (SYS-02 to SYS-05). All six source elements were examined with the No/More/Less/Reverse/Another/Fire-Explosion/Error guidewords across the inlet, vessel, three outlets, E-001 and the listed control and shutdown devices (SYS-06 to SYS-08). Highest priority is loss of liquid seal (low oil level or low interface) causing gas blow-by into the Heater–Treater or water treatment. This is followed by V-001 overpressure and by high level with liquid carryover to fuel gas and burn pit. These initiating deviations are ranked ahead of the generic fire/explosion finding because prevention and verification act at the initiating deviation. The only source-supported procedural hazard is start-up without bypass opening (SYS-09). Credited safeguards are limited to SYS-06 tags whose service, setpoints, independence and fail positions are unstated, so most recommendations are verification actions. Risk classes are qualitative and for prioritisation only.
